description: This file contains implementation of snapshot and screenshot matchers for Playwright testing framework, including functions for comparing images, handling snapshot files, and integrating with test steps.

classes.name: SnapshotHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing snapshot and screenshot comparison, file paths, and result generation.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshot
methods.description: Matcher function to compare a received buffer or string against a stored snapshot, with support for updating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Async matcher function to compare a page or locator screenshot against a stored image, with options for updating and diffing.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshotStepTitle
methods.description: Utility function to generate a step title for screenshot assertions.
